content: During sentence selection we use Trigram Blocking to reduce redundancy BIBREF9. Given summary $S$ and candidate sentence $c$, we skip $c$ if there exists a trigram overlapping between $c$ and $S$. The intuition is similar to Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR; BIBREF29); we wish to minimize the similarity between the sentence being considered and sentences which have been already selected as part of the summary.
